verdict.rationale: Insomnia's collections docs say requests can be sent via HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, and WebSockets. gRPC has dedicated docs covering Protobuf upload, and GraphQL gets schema-based auto-completion and linting. SSE is never mentioned, so one of the four protocols in the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: SSE support evidence, WebSocket detail beyond a single mention, independent or hands-on corroboration of non-REST protocol support.
